_comment: Multi-premise (hyperedge) entailments, split out from pairs.json because neither premise alone entails the conclusion -- forcing these into binary pairs was mislabeling K001/K010's relation to K011 as plain ENTAILS in the v0 draft.

hyperedges.rationale: V=IR (K001) substituted into P=IV (K010) gives P=I^2R (K011). Both premises are required jointly; K001 alone or K010 alone does not entail K011 (see P08, P09 in pairs.json for their individual pairwise classification, which is COMPATIBLE, not ENTAILS).
